speech:
Grizzly Rips, take a seat, because that was a D-minus and I'm not gonna pretend otherwise. We woke up this morning in Division 2 with 6 of 16 points and 2 chances left. We're going to bed in Division 3 with 0 of 12. We got relegated. Then we got handed a promotion series to climb straight back up, won 2 of the first 3, walked into the decider against YummyOrdaFC and got hammered 2-5. One match from erasing the whole mess, and we folded. We conceded 21 goals in 8 matches. That's 2.62 a match. We drew 4 and couldn't close out a single one. Our average rating was 7.45, theirs was 8.01, and on a normal night we're a 7.91 team. Yesterday was an A-minus. Tonight looked like strangers wearing our kit. And two red cards. Two.

PhogsToffees, you ran hard and thought sloppy. You flew into 41 tackles and won 9. That's 22%. Against The Chozen you missed 8 tackles. In the decider you had 0% shot accuracy while their best forward put up a 10.0 next to your 7.3. You averaged an 8.0, well under your usual 8.59. But those 9 assists and that 9.9 in the 7-6 win? That's the real you. I need that one every night.

BellyTb1, a red card in the promotion decider. We played a player down with Division 2 on the line, and that's the match right there. Against Louisville you posted a 6.5, 2 full points under your usual. Against Tøken you missed 5 tackles. And yet you scored 8 and hung a perfect 10.0 on CD CHlVAS, your 8th for us. So I know exactly what's in that tank.

Soup_Kitchen22, rough welcome to the family. You completed 56 of 94 passes, 60%, and against Bloks FC it was 5 of 10. Your red card against CD CHlVAS turned a comfortable night into a 7-6 knife fight, and their best forward put up a 10.0 while you sat at 5.6. You won 5 of 32 tackles. But you put 7 of your 11 shots on target and scored 3. That's the most honest shooting in this room.

Because that's our real problem: shot selection. 64 shots between y'all and only 36 on target. Get it to the middle of the box. Set your feet. Tight angle? Cut it back. A better shot beats a first shot.

Now. My grandma baked bread every Sunday, and the part that scared me as a kid was when she'd punch the dough flat. Just wallop it. I thought she'd ruined it. She told me, "Honey, that's how it learns to rise." Tonight we got punched flat. Relegated, a promotion slipped away, two reds. But we're 29 wins into this season and we've outscored folks 168 to 130. That's not a bad team. That's a good team that had a bad Tuesday.

12 points. 3 chances. Clean slate. Tomorrow we rise, and I can already smell it baking.
